description: This file defines an interface `IControlledTransactionFaultInjector` within the Orleans.Transactions.TestKit namespace, extending `ITransactionFaultInjector`, and includes two boolean properties to control fault injection timing.

classes.name: IControlledTransactionFaultInjector
classes.description: An interface extending `ITransactionFaultInjector` with properties to control fault injection points in transactions.

methods.name: bool InjectBeforeStore
methods.description: Indicates whether to inject a fault before the store operation.

methods.name: bool InjectAfterStore
methods.description: Indicates whether to inject a fault after the store operation.
